text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pulmonary Tuberculosis. The clinical presentation of chronic cough, fever, night sweats, and significant weight loss ("B symptoms"), combined with diffuse infiltrates on chest X-ray and a history of incarceration, is diagnostic for active pulmonary tuberculosis. Immediate isolation and initiation of multi-drug anti-tubercular therapy are indicated.
